title: Reading Pitch
welcome_lead: Spotting middle C and reading up the stave.
meta_desc: KS3 notation: reading pitches on the treble stave.
final_note: Reading pitch unlocks playing from any sheet.

concepts.def: Note in middle of piano, below treble stave.
Set of notes a piece is based on.
First note of a scale, home note.
Series of notes going up or down.

walkthroughs.body_html: Middle C sits in the very middle of a piano. On the treble stave it's drawn one ledger line below the bottom line. Find it first — everything else relates to it.
From middle C up: C, D, E, F, G, A, B, C. D sits below the bottom line. E is the bottom line. F is the first space. Keep going up alphabetically until you reach the next C an octave higher.
The tonic is the home note of a key. In C major, all notes belong to the C major scale: C D E F G A B C. The tonic feels like rest — the place a tune wants to end.
